title: A memory-based active inference model of DishBrain-like adaptive behaviour
abstract: arXiv:2508.06980v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent and rapid advances in artificial intelligence (AI) make it increasingly important to understand the foundations of adaptive behaviour in autonomous agents, especially for building safe and efficient systems. While artificial neural networks have dominated the development of AI, recent work has begun to explore living biological neuronal networks as an alternative substrate for computation. These systems promise remarkable data and sample efficiency and rich dynamics, and may also inspire explainable and biologically plausible models. Here, we develop an experiment-informed active inference framework to model decision-making in closed-loop agents that mirror experimental setups using biological neurons. Using a generative model whose dimensions are matched to an experiment protocol, we systematically compare three decision-making schemes within this common generative model. translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）近期的快速进展使得理解自主智能体自适应行为的基础变得越来越重要，这对于构建安全高效的系统尤为关键。虽然人工神经网络一直主导着AI的发展，但近期的研究已开始探索将活的生物神经元网络作为计算的替代基底。这些系统有望带来卓越的数据和样本效率以及丰富的动力学特性，还可能启发可解释的、符合生物合理性的模型。在本文中，我们开发了一个基于实验信息的主动推理框架，用于建模与生物神经元实验设置相对应的闭环智能体中的决策过程。通过使用维度与实验协议相匹配的生成模型，我们在这一共同的生成模型框架内系统地比较了三种决策方案。在匹配的回合数（即总数据可用性……[摘要在此处被截断]
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于记忆的主动推理框架，用以模拟类DishBrain生物神经元闭环智能体的自适应决策行为，并在与实验协议维度匹配的统一生成模型下系统比较了三种决策方案。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a memory-based active inference framework to model adaptive decision-making in DishBrain-like closed-loop agents, systematically comparing three decision-making schemes within a common generative model whose dimensions are matched to the experimental protocol.
